create.name: Jim Rajan
create.bio:
Jim Rajan is a seer and spiritual teacher based in Madrid whose work centres on highly sensitive people, empaths and intuitives. He spent the first part of his career in London television, producing and directing for MTV UK and other production companies, before turning to intuitive work more than twenty years ago. His family roots run through Persia, northern India and East Africa, and his teaching draws on Hindu philosophy, Buddhism and the Sufi poetry of Rumi. A keen player of the bansuri, the Indian bamboo flute, he studied North Indian classical music and composes the music that accompanies much of his recorded teaching.

His central offer is the Seer Session, a short remote reading in which he describes the deeper patterns he perceives in a client and follows up with recorded audio reflections; clients can then continue in longer mentoring calls. In 2023 he opened The Subtle Qualities School, a nine-month programme with personal accompaniment and a residential retreat in Spain, for sensitive people who want to treat their sensitivity as a strength. He also sells self-paced audio courses on prayer, Rumi, the life of the Buddha and core Hindu ideas such as dharma and karma, several of which also appear on Insight Timer. His book, The Book of Journeys, is a collection of short contemplative pieces.

courses.title: The Seer Session
courses.description: A remote session of about twenty minutes in which Jim describes the deeper patterns he sees in you, followed by recorded audio reflections to return to. It is priced on a sliding scale.

courses.title: Mentoring with Jim (The Harnessing)
courses.description: One-to-one video calls for sensitive people who want to talk through what is moving in their lives and ground it day to day. Often taken after a Seer Session.

courses.title: The Subtle Qualities School
courses.description: A nine-month programme for highly sensitive, creative and perceptive people, with group learning, personal accompaniment from Jim throughout and one residential retreat in Spain. Places are arranged after a conversation.

courses.title: With Rumi as Your Guide
courses.description: Ten self-paced audio sessions that read Rumi's poetry as practical guidance on love, fear, creativity and the ego. Each session is set to Jim's own music and you keep lifetime access.

courses.title: You and the New Power of Prayer
courses.description: Ten audio sessions that treat prayer as a way of living rather than a request, working through intention, trust, beauty, love and light. Set to Jim's own compositions.

courses.title: The Truth: Why Gautama Buddha Appeared In This World
courses.description: Eight audio sessions on the life of the Buddha and ideas such as samvega, the eight worldly winds and sangha, with meditation presented as a practical part of modern life.

courses.title: Hindu Concepts That Will Improve Your Daily Practice
courses.description: A ten-day audio course introducing dharma, karma and other pillars of Hindu thought in plain language, with suggestions for bringing them into everyday practice. No background is assumed.

courses.title: Reclaiming Your Inner States
courses.description: Fourteen short audio sessions, each built around one inner quality such as courage, acceptance or flow, designed to be listened to more than once.

free_resources.title: Jim Rajan on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His Insight Timer page offers guided visualisations, short teachings and bansuri flute music, free to listen to.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 11.4k (profile via WebFetch, 31 Oct 2026); YouTube 36.7k (@TheSubtleQualitiesSchool channel header, 31 Oct 2026); Instagram 75k (@jimrajan og:description, 31 Oct 2026); no Facebook/X linked → ~123k total → luminary
flags: Tier is borderline (~123k total, within 80k–150k); Instagram's 75k is most of it.

His site calls him a 'Professional Seer, Healer and Teacher' and says the Seer Session was formerly called the 'Healing Ceremony'; the plan describes it as an intuitive reading, without healing claims. His mentoring page mentions neurodivergent clients; that wording was left out.
No email is published; the contact form on the Work With Me page is used (a WhatsApp number is also listed).
YouTube titles are in his channel's clickbait capitals and copied as they are; the channel page shows no view counts, so videos were picked as evergreen teaching talks from recent uploads.
The site's audio courses are the same titles as his four Insight Timer courses; the site versions (€25 each) are listed instead of the Insight Timer pages.
Free resources are only the Insight Timer link: no other free practice or download with its own page was found.
